@about: Animated help clips (UI-107), played by ClipView (app/HelpClip.hpp): vector items keyframed in seconds, model coordinates in millimetres (plane view: x right, y up; iso view: z up). Captions, label/chip texts and card titles/rows are English source text translated through app/i18n/<lang>/help.json; they name keys by token ({key:command.id}, {press:command.id}, {fixed:enter}), and a step may add a captionNoKey for when a named command has no key. A key element names the command whose key it shows ({"el": "key", "command": "view.fit"}) or a fixed key ({"fixed": "enter"}; "" in a template: none), never literal caps: the user may have changed the key. All artwork is original and procedural.
@replay: Every sketch clip carries its replay (TODO 11 wave 3; OPAD_BENCH_CLIPREPLAY, app/ClipReplayBench.cpp): the clip's own pointer, keys, typed values and card changes are fed into the tool on a sketch made from "setup", and what the tool made is compared with "expect". setup: tool (default: the clip id's), command (run first), curves and drawn (after the sketch opened: it is modified) as {line: [a, b]} {poly: [...], closed} {rect: [corner, corner]} {circle: c, r} {arc: c, r, start, sweep (degrees, negative clockwise)} {slot: [c1, c2], r} {spline: [...], poles} {point: p}, each optionally construction or linked (points at one place are shared), constraints [{type, on: [curve index, "i.k" its k-th piece, or [x, y] a point], value, label}], patterns [{on, inputs}], options {key: value}, image {corners, angle, opacity, shapes}, file (png, svg, dxf), plane {origin}, bodies [{kind, inputs}] (made by tools/bench_cases/help.py through opad-cli feature). expect: entities and construction (counts by kind; a kind not named is none; [least, most] allowed), linked, constraints {type: count}, dimensions (driving values, mm or degrees), arcs [{center, r, start, sweep}], circles, points, selected, tool, images, image {x, y, width, angle, opacity}, active, sketches (added), page, rings (open ends), snaps [{at, kind}], plane {normal, origin}, file, status, weights, bounds [[u0, v0], [u1, v1], tolerance (default 0.3)] (the extent of the curves), regions (closed regions they enclose), area (the regions together, mm2, within 3 %), during [{t, ...}]: along the way, in time order, what the clip shows at t once the inputs before it are applied: preview (the kinds the tool previews: its rubber band by kind, an Apply tool's result less the sketch, "construction <kind>", "outline", "trim", "extension", "frame", "measure"; true: some, false: none), readouts (texts beside the pointer or an arrow), labels (texts the sketch draws), and any end-state field. A feature's clip (design.*, an iso clip) replays through the view's own mouse handlers: setup sketches [{plane: xy | xz | yz | {base, origin}, curves, constraints}] (in the plane's coordinates; bodies as above), the command (default: the clip id) run, its clicks picked where they land, presses on an arrow dragged, card rows set in the feature panel by their labels; expect features {kind: count}, bodies (added), inputs (the new feature's, as stored: "20 mm"; "~18 mm" within a quarter unit), picks {input: count}, volume (added bodies, within 1 %), total (every body), box [[x0, y0, z0], [x1, y1, z1]], open (the panel), and during: preview (bodies previewed), readouts, values (the panel's inputs now). What it added is undone after it.
